attempts.certificate: U1是字典序最前服务，故U1部署在V1。V1、V2必须各承载一个关键服务，因此U2部署在V2。V3必须承载两个服务，剩余U3、U4均部署在V3；这也满足U3不与U2同服、V3含非关键服务及其他约束。各服务器服务数为[1,1,2]，V3上的服务按字典序为[U3,U4]。

judges.reason: The constraints force U1 onto V1. Since V1 and V2 must each carry exactly one of the two critical services, U2 must be on V2. V3 must carry two services, so the remaining U3 and U4 are both on V3. This assignment satisfies the other constraints and matches all four requested outputs.
judges.depth_evidence: Three dependent steps are needed: use the ordering constraint to place U1 on V1; combine the exact-critical-service constraints with the critical set {U1,U2} to place U2 on V2; then use the remaining services and V3's exact load of two to place U3 and U4 on V3.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate gives the forced placements in order, identifies the remaining two services for V3, and reports the resulting server counts and V3 service list. These conclusions are checkable against the stated constraints, and the proposed assignment satisfies the conditional and separation constraints as well.
